meta.label: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Aerolab collects, uses and protects your personal data.

title: Privacy Policy
intro: At Aerolab we respect your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have over it.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
sections.text: We collect the data you provide directly, such as name, email, address and contact details when creating an account, requesting a service, or contacting us through the contact form or chat.

sections.heading: 2. How we use your information
sections.text: We use your data to manage your account, process orders and payments, respond to inquiries, send notifications related to your orders, and improve our services.

sections.heading: 3. Payments
sections.text: Payments are processed through a specialized external provider. We do not store your full card details on our servers.

sections.heading: 4. Data retention
sections.text: We retain your data for as long as you keep an active account or as needed to comply with legal, accounting or order management obligations.

sections.heading: 5. Security
sections.text: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information, including password encryption and access control to our systems.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.text: You can request access, correction or deletion of your personal data by contacting us through the contact page.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
sections.text: We use local browser storage to remember your preferences, such as language and visual theme.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.text: We may update this policy from time to time. Changes take effect as soon as they are published on this page.
